brief.summary: Equities were modestly higher after a three-day slide, while front-end yields fell 6-7bp after Waller and the curve steepened; long-end yields edged lower. The dollar weakened and dollar-yen slid toward 156 on yen intervention and BoJ hike speculation. Oil rose sharply, with Brent near $97 after four sessions of gains on Iran/Hormuz risk; credit spreads stayed tight and gold was described as ticking up. The Fed remains hawkish, with markets pricing more than 60% odds of a September hike and Waller saying CPI will decide. The dominant narrative is a rates-versus-earnings debate, with AI earnings mixed and geopolitics escalating. Overall tone is neutral.
